But when Polly held the sapphire gemstone, she could throw the javelin three times farther than when not holding the gemstone. outputs:
Let $d$ be the distance Polly can throw the javelin without the gemstone.

When Polly holds the sapphire gemstone, she can throw the javelin three times farther than when not holding the gemstone. So, $D = 3d = 3(233) = 699$ feet.
The dragon's flames reach a distance of 34 feet.

Therefore, Polly can stand 665 feet outside of the dragon's flames and still hit the dragon with the gold javelin.
